set.auditSummary: Official FAQ and package comparison checked 17 November 2026. The provider lists 51010, 510Zero, NoPC and Customize with materially different limits; the NoPC absence of profit consistency must not be generalized to other packages. The FAQ says a trader above the profit-consistency ceiling must continue trading until the best-day ratio falls; otherwise risk management rejects the payout. On 510Zero, performance below 6% leads to a fixed 10% share, raised to an 8% trigger for clients in Vietnam, Indonesia and Thailand. A 'Reactivate Profit Sharing' action after a risk-consistency breach can make the next reward share 20% before gradual recovery. The risk team may impose additional conditions on suspected abnormal trading. Its 'up to 90%' and average 24-hour processing claims do not convey these eligibility thresholds. Trustpilot's previously recorded rating-withheld/fake-review notice remains in the incident record. No independent payout audit, execution latency or live spread measurement was performed.

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. WSFunded sells Instant Funded Pro (2.5K to 100K, 5% trailing drawdown, 15% best-day rule) and Instant Funded Standard (2.5K to 50K, 6% trailing drawdown that never drops, 30% best-day rule), which pay first after 15 days and then every 10 days. It also sells the Classic (8%/5%, 8% static) and Ultra (10%/5%, 10% static) two-phase challenges, Rapid and Prime one-phase challenges, and Power (MT5 only, $9.99 to start, 6% trailing drawdown once funded, 20% best-day rule, payouts every 14 days). The plan tables show two unlabelled prices per size, so list prices are not recorded. The help articles require a stop loss within two minutes, cap risk per trade idea at 1% of balance (instant and Power) or 50% of the daily drawdown (two-phase), and forbid trades under 60 seconds. On funded accounts, they ban opening or closing trades within 4 minutes of red-folder news. The Terms & Conditions add that the firm may cancel participation 'for any reason it deems appropriate', a warning ladder that delays payouts on all accounts, a ban on copy trading on funded accounts and on third-party EAs (while the Classic article says EAs are allowed), and permanent suspension for bank chargebacks. Entities: WSF Technology FZCO (Dubai), WSFmarkets Ltd (Saint Lucia) and RENATICA LTD. (Cyprus, payments); the terms do not name the governing country. Payout evidence was not verified.

Its '48h Payout' costs an additional 20% of the evaluation fee and grants eligibility to request a reward every two active trading days, rather than proving receipt within 48 hours. set.auditSummary: 17 November 2026 deep review of official full terms and FAQ, building on the October product-price snapshot. The 1-Step '48h Payout' option costs 20% extra and shortens the reward-request waiting period in the Final Stage from seven active trading days to two; this should not be described as a guaranteed 48-hour bank settlement. A separate 90% bonus-performance add-on also costs 20% of the evaluation fee, so promotional reward percentages are not universally included in headline prices. The written terms identify separate 1-Step Classic, Pro and Turbo goals and distinguish 2-phase/Ascend and Break programs. The provider explicitly reserves review of instruments, holding times, position size and risk profile before considering a scholarship. Trading fees vary with platform and instrument, but actual live spreads, slippage and transfer receipt were not measured by PropRadar. Prior program card parameters that could not be mapped unambiguously remain marked unverified.

restrictiveRules.rule: The FAQ says "exploitative or unrealistic strategies are not allowed", naming high-frequency trading, tick scalping (manual or by EA/bot), latency arbitrage and multi-account reverse-trading EAs. Terms 7.1 adds hedging or reverse trading; for listed breaches "your participation will be terminated, which may include the loss of the established returns".

restrictiveRules.rule: FAQ: "The maximum simulated profit allowed per day and/or per trade is $10,000." Terms 7.1(xiii): "the amount that exceeds $10,000 will be deducted".

restrictiveRules.rule: "No single trading day may account for more than 40% of the total profits generated on the account", checked when a payout is requested; Terms 7.1(xxiv): "the payout request shall be rejected until the requirement is fulfilled".
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout request is refused until the best day falls under 40% of total profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: FAQ: on Ascend "you cannot open new trades or increase your risk during high-impact news events or market openings"; Terms 7.1(xxi) sets the window at "two minutes before and after high-impact news or market opening". Breaches of section 7.1 can terminate participation, "which may include the loss of the established returns".
restrictiveRules.impact: Opening or adding to a trade around high-impact news can end the Ascend account and its profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: 1-Step: a reward can be requested every 7 traded days (2 with the paid 48h Payout add-on). 2-Phase: "after trading for at least 15 days, or alternatively, every 30 calendar days."
restrictiveRules.impact: Rewards cannot be requested before the stated number of traded days.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 7.1(viii) prohibits "operating multiple accounts from the same household, devices, or IP address/VPS" and adds "The user is responsible for the risk of using VPNs, as these could lead to IP matches with other users." Terms 3.2.5 allows eligibility checks using devices, "without the right to compensation or refund for the benefits withdrawn".
restrictiveRules.impact: An IP or device match with another user, including through a VPN, can end the accounts without reward or refund.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 8(ix): the firm "may review the trading activity of any account, including before processing a scholarship request" (position sizing, risk per trade, holding times, overall risk profile) and "adjust the eligible scholarship amount". Terms 7.1(xv) bans "non-investment, i.e., gambling" without a definition; Terms 3.1.10 allows it to "terminate accounts ... at our sole discretion, without providing any reason".
restrictiveRules.impact: A reward can be reduced, or an account closed, on a case-by-case assessment by the firm.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 7.3: "Access to this platform is not available to users residing in the United States." The FAQ says "There are currently no country restrictions for traders using Match-Trader" and only closes MetaTrader 5 to US residents. Terms 3.2.5 lets the firm withdraw benefits found ineligible "without the right to compensation or refund".

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. The product pages list 2 Phase accounts from $49 (5K) to $1,079 (200K) with 8%/5% targets, 5% daily and 8% total loss and five trading days, Instant Funding from $199 (5K) to $979 (50K), and a $100,000 Rapid challenge at $549 with a 5% target, 3% daily and 5% total loss; the pages also state that MT5 accounts are migrating to TradeLocker and that new orders are currently paused. The FAQ restricts trading 10 minutes before and after major releases, bans high-frequency trading, hedge arbitrage, tick scalping, grid trading and copy trading on funded accounts, requires one trade every 30 days, limits traders to three challenges totalling $600,000 and excludes residents of listed countries. The March 2026 rules read on 18 November cap each of the first three payouts at 5% of account size, apply a 30% best-day limit and a 14-day wait, and keep payout approval at the company's discretion; they could not be re-read today. Payout evidence, the legal entity and the firm's current operating status remain unverified.

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. The Terms describe three challenges: One-Step (9% target, 3% daily, 6% trailing), Two-Step (8% then 5%, 4% daily, 8% static) and Three-Step (6% per phase, 4% daily, 7% static), all $5K to $250K with five minimum trading days, unlimited time and 50:1 leverage; Lite plans (50/50) and a $1 promo plan (20% share) also exist. Only the 2 Step $25K list price of $189 is shown; the checkout could not be read. Funded traders keep 90%; the first payout comes after 14 days and five trading days of at least 0.5% of the target, then every 7 days, with trading locked while a payout is processed. The homepage states a $500 minimum payout, while Terms 5.2.1 set $200 or 2% of account size. The Terms require strategy and position size to stay consistent between phases, expect no more than 2% risk per trade, prohibit AI, HFT and unauthorised copy trading, close accounts after 15 days of inactivity, allow one account per person, and let FundedBull terminate 'for any reason', with forfeiture of profits for violations. News trading is barred 5 minutes around events on challenge accounts only. Payout evidence was not verified.

restrictiveRules.rule: The first payout needs at least 14 days and 5 trading days; a day counts only if it makes at least 0.5% of the profit target (e.g. $500 on a $100,000 account), and trading style and assets must match those of the counted days.
restrictiveRules.impact: Small winning days do not count toward the payout requirement.

restrictiveRules.rule: The homepage states a $500 minimum payout on the funded account; the trading-rules page says trading 'is automatically locked' when a payout is requested and resumes once it is fully processed, and only accounts that are 'not breached' are eligible.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits below $500 cannot be withdrawn, and the account cannot be traded while a payout is processed.

restrictiveRules.rule: Strategy, risk management and execution must stay consistent from the challenge to the funded phase ('Replicability'); Terms 4.1 say the approach 'should align with those of your most profitable day' and 6.1.10 prohibits 'positions with sizes that are noticeably larger or smaller than those of the Customer's other trades'. Terms 3.5: violations may lead to 'forfeiture of any profits or funds'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Changing position size or style between phases can lead to forfeiture, with no numeric threshold stated.

restrictiveRules.rule: The rules prohibit 'any other form of abusive trading' and discourage 'going all-in'; Terms 6.1.11 expect no more than 2% of equity risked per trade, 7.1 lists 'Abusive Behavior' as a ground for suspension or termination and says FundedBull 'reserves the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time for any reason'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Accounts and profits can be ended on grounds that are not defined in advance.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 6.1.4 prohibit 'Using any software, artificial intelligence, ultra-high-speed trading, high-frequency trading, or mass data entry' giving an unfair advantage; 6.1.7 bars unauthorised copy trading; the rules page bars signal services, group trading and passing services. Violations may lead to forfeiture of profits (3.5).
restrictiveRules.impact: Automated or AI-assisted trading can cost the account's profits.

set.verdict: Axi Select is not a classic paid simulated challenge. The trader must open and fund a real Axi brokerage account, and capital allocation grows through six qualifying stages. set.auditSummary: 18 November 2026: reviewed Axi Select six-stage Seed, Incubation, Acceleration, Pro, Pro500 and ProM official programme information. Typical stage equity requirements increase $500, $1,000, $2,000, $5,000, $10,000 and $20,000 of trader-owned broker capital respectively, against advertised allocations $5K, $20K, $100K, $200K, $500K and $1M. Static maximum allocation loss is 7% on early stages and 10% for ProM; loss in live equity counts. Stage advancement generally requires a 7% gain, minimum weeks/trades and the programme Edge score. Withdrawals from a real broker balance can lower programme allocation in proportion without lowering the previously defined loss floor, potentially causing immediate failure. Axi support gives different country eligibility answers depending on its regional legal entity, including region-restricted availability, and registration country must be truthful. set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. Atmos Funded describes three main programmes in its help centre: 1-Step Nova (5% target, 4% daily, 8% trailing loss, $5 evaluation then a funded fee of $79 for 10K to $1,029 for 200K, on-demand payouts after seven profitable days of 0.5%, 1% per-symbol daily risk limit), 2-Step Standard (10% then 5%, 5% daily, 10% static, three days per phase, $63 to $989, 14-day payouts) and Instant Funding (3% daily, 5% trailing that locks at the initial balance on payout, 20% consistency, $75 to $649). The rules page removes profit from funded trades within 2 minutes of high-impact news (the customer agreement says 5 minutes), bans commercial EAs, martingale, grid and hedging across accounts, and closes breached accounts with profits forfeited. The AtmosFunded Ltd customer agreement (Cyprus law) adds a 45-second minimum hold and 30 trades per hour soft limits, IP and device rules, termination 'without cause' at the company's discretion, and a standard 80/20 split with higher splits sold as add-ons, while marketing pages state up to 90%. Payout evidence and the Comoros licence were not verified.

restrictiveRules.rule: The rules page says news trading in the funded stage 'is not permitted within 2 minutes before or after the event' and profits from violating trades are removed; the customer agreement (Schedule A 2.1(ix)) says 'within 5 minutes before and after' and that such profits 'shall be deleted'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit from trades near high-impact news is removed; the official documents disagree on whether the window is 2 or 5 minutes.

restrictiveRules.rule: The anti-gambling policy prohibits one-sided bets, chasing price, aggressive averaging, martingale, grid, tick scalping and hyperactivity, and requires a consistent trading style across all phases (abrupt changes need approval). 'Violations can lead to profit removal, suspension, or breach.'
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits can be removed or the account breached based on how the firm classifies a trading style.

restrictiveRules.program: All programmes — minimum hold time and trade frequency
restrictiveRules.rule: Customer agreement Schedule A: soft-breach limits of a 'minimum hold of 45 seconds per trade' and '30 trades / hr'; closing trades 'within 15 seconds or less' is prohibited tick scalping; the company may 'wipe out any accumulated PnL' after multiple soft breaches or any hard breach.
restrictiveRules.impact: Repeated short trades can lead to all accumulated profit being removed; stated only in the customer agreement.

restrictiveRules.program: All programmes — IP, VPN and devices
restrictiveRules.rule: Customer agreement Schedule A 2.1(x): 'inconsistent IP addresses, sharing devices or credentials' and improper VPN/VPS use are prohibited; breach can lead to suspension or termination.
restrictiveRules.impact: Logging in from changing IPs or a shared device can end the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Commercial EAs are strictly prohibited'; EAs are allowed only if they reflect the trader's own strategy. Using banned strategies is a breach after which 'the account is immediately closed, all open trades are terminated, and any profits in the account are forfeited.'
restrictiveRules.impact: Running an off-the-shelf EA can close the account and forfeit its profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: Consistency rule: '20% (no single day >20% of total profit (based on equity))'.
restrictiveRules.impact: A large single day delays payout eligibility until total profit grows.

restrictiveRules.program: Instant Funding — trailing drawdown on the funded account
restrictiveRules.rule: Max total drawdown '5% Trailing'; 'Once a payout is requested, the drawdown is locked in at the initial account balance', and requesting a full payout means 'you will instantly breach the total drawdown'.
restrictiveRules.impact: The loss limit follows gains until the first payout, and only part of the profit can be withdrawn without breaching.

restrictiveRules.rule: Customer agreement Schedule A: the challenge expires after '60 calendar days' of inactivity (1-Stage and 2-Stage; not Instant).
restrictiveRules.impact: An untraded challenge expires after 60 days.

restrictiveRules.rule: '3 per phase (0.5% counts as a profitable day)'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Each evaluation phase needs at least three trading days.

restrictiveRules.rule: Funded stage: payouts need 7 profitable days, each with at least 0.5% of the initial balance (not necessarily consecutive); eligibility starts on the 8th day and the 7 days reset after each payout.
restrictiveRules.impact: Each Nova payout needs a fresh set of seven qualifying days.

restrictiveRules.rule: Funded stage 'risk protection': combined closed and floating risk per symbol should not exceed 1% in a single day. The article does not state the consequence of exceeding it.
restrictiveRules.impact: Limits position size per instrument each day on the funded account.

restrictiveRules.program: 1-Step Nova — trailing drawdown on the funded account
restrictiveRules.rule: Funded stage keeps an 8% trailing maximum loss; once a payout is requested the drawdown locks at the initial account balance, so 'a full withdrawal would breach the drawdown' and a buffer must be kept.
restrictiveRules.impact: The loss limit follows gains until the first payout, and only part of the profit can be withdrawn without breaching.

restrictiveRules.program: All programmes — cross-account hedging and mirroring
restrictiveRules.rule: The rules page lists hedging across multiple accounts as a breach trigger, after which 'the account is immediately closed' and profits are forfeited; the customer agreement (Schedule A 2.1(iv)-(v), clause 8.1(xi)) also forbids opposite positions across accounts, 'coordinated trading activities across different accounts to mirror positions' without authorisation, and arbitrage across accounts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Holding opposite or mirrored positions across several accounts can close them and forfeit their profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: Customer agreement clause 8.3: the company may terminate 'without cause' in its 'sole and absolute discretion' with written notice; clauses 2.7 and 7.5 state that loss of access carries no compensation and no refund of fees; Schedule A 5 allows payments owed after a hard breach to be halted, withdrawn or set off.
restrictiveRules.impact: The account and pending payouts can be ended without a stated reason; stated only in the agreement.

setProducts.maxDailyLoss: $500 (trading stops for the day; no more than 3 per challenge)
setProducts.drawdownDetails: Type not stated.
setProducts.consistencyRule: Not stated on the TrueEdge page; a second official page (/how-it-works-2/) mentions a 10% consistency ratio. Other pass tests: 80 round turns, W/L ratio 1.20+, 40% BAT, largest win above largest loss, 1,000-share cap, intraday only.

restrictiveRules.program: DayTraders.com Trail / Static / EOD evaluations versus Pro
restrictiveRules.rule: Evaluations require two qualifying days and at most 50% of total profit from the best day. The subsequent simulated Pro payout cycle has a stricter 30% best-day rule and needs eight qualifying days between payouts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Passing a two-day evaluation does not mean the Pro account can pay after two days; the payout calendar and concentration ratio change after passage.

restrictiveRules.program: DayTraders.com S2F instant / S2L live programme
restrictiveRules.rule: S2F has an EOD trailing limit, 20% best-day consistency per payout cycle and ten qualifying payout days. S2L evaluation has an intraday trailing loss and a 25% best-day limit, then a live 80/20 split with no live consistency rule.
restrictiveRules.impact: The similarly advertised instant and live tracks have fundamentally different drawdown, consistency, payout and capital-execution mechanics.

restrictiveRules.rule: Official EOD help lists end-of-day trailing loss floors of $1,000 / $2,000 / $4,000 / $6,500 and daily loss limits of $800 / $1,250 / $2,000 / $3,250 across those sizes.
restrictiveRules.impact: The EOD model is not the same as a static drawdown or intraday trail; a loss-limit breach can occur before the headline profit goal.

restrictiveRules.program: All programmes — Terms of Use section 26 (Prohibited Conduct)
restrictiveRules.rule: Trading that 'knowingly or unknowingly circumvents targets and rules or generates profits that could not otherwise be achieved in live market trading' violates the terms; Day Traders 'reserve[s] the right to determine in our sole discretion' what counts as a noncompliant practice, and may 'remove any Simulated Account profits, delete a trading day, reset an Account, or ban a User'. A trader found to have profited from the simulated environment 'will not be entitled to receive any withdrawals from any other account maintained with Day Traders, all of which will be forfeited and closed immediately'. Section 3 adds a 'gambling type behavior' clause (e.g. more than 3 resets in 24 hours) with consequences 'at our own discretion'. Trading Rules can change 'with or without notice'.
restrictiveRules.impact: A finding on one account can cancel withdrawals on every other account, on the firm's own reading of undefined standards, including conduct that was not intentional.

restrictiveRules.program: Pro (Trail / Static / EOD) and S2F — call to live
restrictiveRules.rule: Pro and S2F traders 'may be invited to a live account at the firm's discretion'. Once live, simulated accounts are closed and 'Excess simulated balances are generally forfeited, but they may be used as performance rewards in live, subject to the Risk Team's discretion.' If called to live on a payout day, all that day's requests are added together: at $10,000 or more, 'half is paid to your Payout Method and half becomes your live account's max drawdown'. Pro accounts with no payout yet are refunded with their evaluations.
restrictiveRules.impact: Simulated profits above what has been withdrawn can be lost when the firm moves the trader to live, and half of a large same-day payout is redirected into the live account's drawdown instead of being paid.

restrictiveRules.program: Trail and EOD Pro accounts — payout limits
restrictiveRules.rule: Maximum per request $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,500 / $5,000 for 25K / 50K / 150K / 300K; the balance must stay at or above $26,000 / $52,000 / $153,500 / $305,000 after the payout; minimum request $500.
restrictiveRules.impact: Each eight-qualifying-day cycle releases at most the per-request cap; larger profits stay in the account at risk.

restrictiveRules.rule: Each cycle needs new profit since the last payout of $2,000 / $3,500 / $10,000 (first), then $1,500 / $3,000 / $5,000, then $1,000 / $2,500 / $3,500 for 25K / 50K / 150K; maximum per request $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000.
restrictiveRules.impact: On a 150K S2F account a $10,000 first-cycle target unlocks a request of at most $3,000.

restrictiveRules.rule: Every account needs trading days meeting the plan's minimum daily profit in every rolling 30-day window: at least 1 for Monthly billing and 'At least 4 trading days meeting the minimum daily profit' for Lifetime (one-time) accounts. If missed, the account is marked Inactive and closed; 'Inactive accounts can't be reactivated'.
restrictiveRules.impact: This is a recurring profit requirement, not just a trading-activity check: a Lifetime funded account with fewer than four sufficiently profitable days in any 30-day window is closed.

restrictiveRules.program: All programmes — one login per household
restrictiveRules.rule: 'One login per household. If multiple accounts in a household are detected, all accounts may be subject to closure and all simulated or live profits forfeited.' Accounts cannot be shared or transferred.
restrictiveRules.impact: Two traders in one household holding separate logins risk losing all accounts and profits, including live profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: Hedging and high-frequency trading (orders placed, modified or cancelled 'in milliseconds') are prohibited. 'If a prohibited strategy is confirmed, all accounts involved are closed and unpaid profits on them are forfeited. Serious or repeat violations lead to a full ban. Payouts approved before the finding are honored.' The terms extend hedging to correlated instruments across accounts.
restrictiveRules.impact: A confirmed violation ends every involved account and cancels its unpaid profit.

restrictiveRules.program: All programmes — position size versus own history
restrictiveRules.rule: Terms section 26 prohibits 'opening positions in substantially larger quantity than other trades on the Day Traders Accounts', 'grossly overleveraged' positions and martingale; 'Excessive or unrealistic single day trades or single trade profits will be subject to review'. No threshold is defined; remedies are those of section 26 (profit removal, account closure, ban).
restrictiveRules.impact: A trade much larger than one's usual size can be treated as prohibited even inside the published contract limit, with no numeric threshold to check against.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'If you are a citizen of an OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) or restricted country, we can't provide services to you, wherever you are located.' About 80 countries are listed, including Cyprus, China, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Thailand, Ukraine and South Africa; 'Attempts to circumvent this may result in account closure'. Programmes are for non-professional traders only (no Series licence or SEC/NFA registration); the terms say a professional's account 'will be terminated effective immediately'. Payout setup requires an SSN or a passport/government ID number.
restrictiveRules.impact: Eligibility depends on citizenship as well as residence and on non-professional status; it is checked at payout setup.

restrictiveRules.program: Orion Zero and funded Orion Nova — best-day ratio
restrictiveRules.rule: At payout request, the single most profitable day cannot exceed 20% of cycle profit. This rule does not apply in Nova evaluation and does not apply to Standard, Swing or Select.
restrictiveRules.impact: The instant Zero and funded Nova paths may require further trading to dilute one large profitable day; other tiers should not be labelled with this rule.

restrictiveRules.program: Orion Zero and Nova — funded reward buffer
restrictiveRules.rule: The first 3% of profit is retained as a non-withdrawable safety cushion before a reward request may be made.
restrictiveRules.impact: The advertised profit split does not make the initial 3% of account growth withdrawable on these two programs.

restrictiveRules.rule: Trades opened or closed within five minutes of a high-impact event remain permitted but are rewarded with a 50% profit split rather than the normal 80%.
restrictiveRules.impact: The same profitable trade can have a materially smaller share because of its timing around an economic release.

restrictiveRules.program: Funded Nova, Standard and Select — high-impact news
restrictiveRules.rule: No opens, closes, modifications or stop orders are allowed within two minutes before or after a high-impact event. Funded Swing has no such news restriction.
restrictiveRules.impact: Leaving a pre-existing trade open through the window is distinguished from changing it; the affected programmes require order-management discipline.

restrictiveRules.rule: Nova charges a small $7 evaluation registration fee and a separate funded activation fee after passing; the activation must be paid within 30 days after completion.
restrictiveRules.impact: The $7 introductory price is not the full amount required to access a Nova funded account.

restrictiveRules.program: All Orion programmes — trades 'not replicable on a live account'
restrictiveRules.rule: The Forbidden Trading Practices article bans trades 'not replicable on a live account', listed as 'overleveraging, overexposure, one-sided bets, and account rolling', and treats as non-standard risk management 'position sizes that are substantially larger than your other trades' or 'substantially more or fewer positions than your normal pattern'. No numeric threshold is given. Orion 'may remove trades from your history, restrict platform access, disqualify the evaluation', forfeit pending rewards or terminate all active agreements, depending on the situation.
restrictiveRules.impact: Whether a trade pattern breaches the rule is decided by Orion without a published threshold, and the stated consequences include losing pending rewards and every account.

restrictiveRules.program: Orion Standard, Swing, Select and Nova — admission to the Orion Trader Program
restrictiveRules.rule: After all evaluation phases are passed, Orion recommends the trader for the Orion Trader Program; 'a third party reviews your application and, if accepted', offers an Orion Trader Account contract. The terms (7.6) add that passing 'does not guarantee your acceptance into the Orion Trader Program'. Acceptance criteria are not published.
restrictiveRules.impact: Passing the evaluation does not by itself give a funded account; the review criteria are not stated.

restrictiveRules.program: All Orion programmes — grid and martingale
restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 10.3.5: grid trading is prohibited at any stage and 'the opening of four or more simultaneous positions in the same asset' is treated as an indication of grid trading; such accounts 'will be disqualified'. Terms 10.3.2: increasing position size after losses (martingale) is prohibited and rewards may be 'partially or totally nullified'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Holding four or more positions on one symbol at once can be read as grid trading and lead to disqualification.

restrictiveRules.program: All Orion programmes — EAs and copy trading
restrictiveRules.rule: EAs or robots that generate 'more than 2,000 server requests per day' are not permitted (help centre). The terms (10.3.1) allow copying between accounts of the same person but prohibit copying via 'external copy-trading services or third-party tools', and (10.2) ban 'automated systems, ultra-fast trading software or mass data entry programs' used to manipulate or gain an unfair advantage. Stated consequences include trade removal and disqualification.
restrictiveRules.impact: High-frequency EAs and third-party copy services are excluded; a breach can cost the account.

restrictiveRules.program: All Orion programmes — news trading as a strategy
restrictiveRules.rule: The news page states there are no timing restrictions in evaluation but that 'news trading as a strategy is prohibited in all phases'; the terms (11.6) prohibit 'any trading strategy explicitly designed to capitalize on news volatility' where restrictions apply. 'News trading as a strategy' is not defined. Breaches 'may have the related profit adjusted, deducted, or voided'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Even on Swing and in evaluation, a news-driven approach can be challenged under an undefined standard, with profit adjustment as the stated consequence.

restrictiveRules.rule: Opening trades specifically to exploit price gaps is banned around scheduled 'major global news, macroeconomic events, or earnings releases' and 'within 2 hours of a relevant market closing for at least 2 hours'. Holding an existing position through a session close is allowed.
restrictiveRules.impact: New positions opened shortly before a long market closure can be treated as gap trading.

restrictiveRules.program: Orion Standard — overnight and weekend holding
restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 7.2.3 (last updated 22 March 2026) state that holding positions overnight or over weekends is not permitted for Orion Standard, while the help centre states that holding overnight and over weekends 'is permitted on every Orion program, in both the evaluation and funded phases'. The two official documents contradict each other.
restrictiveRules.impact: A Standard trader holding over a weekend relies on the help-centre wording against the signed terms.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 7.4: an account with no transactions for '30 consecutive calendar days' is marked expired, and this period 'cannot be extended or altered'; 16.2: the agreement terminates if no simulated trade is opened in 30 consecutive calendar days.
restrictiveRules.impact: An account left untraded for 30 days ends.

restrictiveRules.program: All Orion programmes — KYC deadline and restricted countries
restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 8.6: 'After passing the evaluation phase, traders must complete KYC verification within 30 calendar days.' Terms 1.2: restricted jurisdictions 'include United Arab Emirates, Bangladesh, North Korea, Syria' and others listed on the website; 8.5: no contracts with non-profit organisations or trusts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Residents of listed countries cannot use the service, and verification must be completed within 30 days of passing.

set.payoutDelay: 14-day reward cycle with no initial waiting period; approved rewards stated to be paid within 48 hours (late payment: 100% reward plus programme-fee refund, terms 7.10.2); Zero and Nova keep a 3% non-withdrawable cushion and a 20% best-day ratio
set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. Orion Funded (OGM International Ltd, Saint Lucia) sells five CFD models on MT5 and MatchTrader: Standard and Swing (2-step), Select (3-step), Nova (1-step, $7 registration then an activation fee after passing) and the instant Zero; static drawdown on the stepped models, a trailing lock on Nova and Zero. The terms state an 80% split, a 14-day reward cycle, a 48-hour payment promise backed by a fee refund if late, and a fee refund after four reward splits. Zero and funded Nova add a 20% best-day ratio and a non-withdrawable 3% cushion; funded Nova, Standard and Select restrict orders two minutes around high-impact news and Zero pays 50% on trades near news. The heaviest fine print: trades 'not replicable on a live account' (overleveraging, one-sided bets, account rolling) can lead to removed trades, forfeited rewards and termination with no numeric threshold; four or more simultaneous positions in one asset are treated as grid trading; EAs above 2,000 server requests a day and external copy services are banned; funded access follows a third-party review that passing does not guarantee; accounts expire after 30 days without trading. The terms PDF (22 March 2026) contradicts the help centre on overnight holding for Standard, Swing's drawdown and minimum days. Per-size prices, payout evidence and the legal file were not verified.
set.verdict: Orion Funded sells Standard, Swing, Select, Nova and the instant Zero account with an 80% split and a 14-day reward cycle. The help centre and terms add a discretionary 'not replicable on a live account' ban, a grid indicator at four simultaneous positions per asset, and third-party review before funding. Payout evidence was not verified.

changelog.summary: Compared all five official programs and added separately sourced 20% Zero/Nova best-day limit, 3% retained reward cushion, program-specific news restrictions and Nova post-pass activation payment. The two product consistency descriptions are now precise; no generic company-wide consistency is inferred.

Programs read on the official pages: Standard 2-Step ($49 to $1,149, 6% / 6%, 3% daily, 6% static), Select 3-Step ($59 to $739, 5% x 3, 5% static), Nova 1-Step ($7 plus $69 to $1,099 activation, 4% target, 8% then 5% funded) and Zero instant ($199 to $1,149, 6%), 80% split, withdrawals every 14 days processed within 48 hours. The help center gives Zero and Nova a trailing-lock drawdown and the 2- and 3-step programs a static one, so the firm is recorded as hybrid; the Nova and Zero product pages describe the limit as absolute on the initial balance. Orion Swing (8% / 5%, 5% daily, 8% static) has no sizes on these pages. Footer: OGM International Ltd. (Saint Lucia) and Orion Global FZCO, already on file.

set.verdict: Atlas Funded's current general terms specify an 80% standard funded split, add-on-dependent first withdrawals and a 50% share on the first on-demand payout. Funded news-event profit can be excluded from a payout even without an account breach, and short-duration trading strategies can be restricted. Its '$1 to start' route defers the balance until after a pass; it is not a $1 full challenge. Compare terms with the exact purchased model before paying.
set.auditSummary: Official terms and $1 Start Access program reviewed on 17 November 2026. General terms set an 80% default trader share, potentially increased by add-ons. Default first payout is after 30 days from the first funded trade; biweekly add-on starts at day 30 then every 14 days, and weekly add-on starts day 21 then every 7 days. The first on-demand withdrawal instead uses a 50% share; later ones return to normal. Approved requests are processed in 1–5 business days, not guaranteed within 24 hours. On funded accounts, profit from positions opened/closed within five minutes of high-impact news may be deducted even if this does not count as a rule breach. Certain sub-three-minute strategies, cross-firm copy trading and unapproved EAs are restricted. The 'Start Access' $1 upfront marketing requires deferred payment after a pass; special-product terms and public program pages may differ from general terms. Firm-hosted payout screenshots are not independently validated transactions.

set.verdict: SuperFunded's October 2026 rulebook makes a headline 90% split misleading for early Two-Step withdrawals: the first approved payout receives 70%, the second 80%, and only later payouts 90%. Distribution limits, a first-three-payout profit cap, funded news restrictions and discretionary payout review materially affect the trader's outcome. This is an official-rules audit, not an independently verified trading or withdrawal test.
set.auditSummary: Official Rules and Conditions V2 (22 October 2026) reviewed on 17 November. One-Step funded payouts carry an 80% share; Two-Step pays 70% on the first payout, 80% on the second and 90% thereafter. Requests require at least $100 after the split and a 14-day waiting period; approved payouts are typically processed within 24–48 hours, with KYC or video reviews possible. Consequences are at the risk team's discretion and include 'Deduction of all profits.', 'Rejection of withdrawal requests.', 'Reduction of profit split to 20-25%.' and termination 'without notice'. Terms 3.3: 'all payouts are fully at the discretion of the Company'; Terms 6.9 and 9.5 say the Company 'retains the sole authority to define the scope of the behaviours'.

A separate article defines over-leveraging as excessive leverage that 'reduces the account's Margin Level to 150% or lower' and says 'Violating this rule may result in a payout denial, reset to Phase 1, or a hard breach.' Terms 9.6(iv) also allow leverage to be reduced to 1:5.

Also prohibited: martingale, grid trading and group or multi-account reverse hedging. Consequences listed in the same article include deduction of all profits and rejection of withdrawal requests.

SFX International FZCO (Dubai, DSO-FZCO-21983), whose Terms say it is 'not registered or regulated', sells three simulated programmes on Match-Trader: a 2-Step Challenge (8% then 5% targets, 4% daily, 8% static maximum loss), a 1-Step Pro (9% target, no daily limit, 6% maximum loss) and Instant Plans in Standard, Pro and Flex variants. Only 100K prices are displayed ($499, $699 and $599 list). The plan pages advertise an 85% split rising to 100%, on-demand rewards and a '100% Refundable' fee, but the Refund Policy refunds the evaluation fee only with the fifth profit split payment. The heaviest clauses sit in the help centre and Terms: VPN or VPS use can breach the account; a 'gamble to pass' rule treats risking more than about 1-2% per trade idea as prohibited; more than four layered orders, news bracketing, third-party EAs and copy trading are banned; and the risk team may deduct all profits, reject withdrawals or cut the split to 20-25%. Terms 3.3 state 'all payouts are fully at the discretion of the Company'. Funded payouts also need a best-day Stability Index at or below 15-25% depending on the plan, and on-demand payouts need 3% profit. Payout cadence is described as on demand, every 14 business days and every 21 days on different official pages. Payout records have not been independently verified.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM 2-Step Plus — Shield Risk Protocol on funded accounts
restrictiveRules.rule: Floating unrealized loss at 1% of initial account size auto-closes positions and progressively cuts the 70% trader split to 50%, 40%, 30%, then permanently 20% on the fourth breach.
restrictiveRules.impact: A trader may avoid the advertised 10% overall stop-out yet suffer a permanent reduction in revenue share after smaller floating-loss events.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM 2-Step Plus — optional 90% split during evaluation
restrictiveRules.rule: The free 90% split add-on applies the Shield Protocol already during evaluation; first trigger is soft, second is a hard breach that fails the evaluation.
restrictiveRules.impact: Selecting the apparently free higher split changes the pass/fail risk profile before funding.

restrictiveRules.rule: Highest day cannot exceed 50% of the target in evaluation or 45% of total profit in funded simulation before withdrawal; exceeding the ratio means continuing to trade until compliant.
restrictiveRules.impact: A successful profit target or a profitable funded balance may still be ineligible for approval or withdrawal.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM — all accounts, prohibited trading practices
restrictiveRules.rule: The FAQ lists prohibited practices including external or slow data feeds, exploiting service errors, hedging across accounts, group trading, high-frequency trading, news scalping, arbitrage, tick scalping, reverse trading, account sharing, account management services and mirroring trades; for any of them 'we reserve the right to close the account and forfeit any associated performance reward without a refund'. Bots are allowed except high-frequency, news-scalping, arbitrage, tick-scalping, multi-account reverse, demo-server exploit bots and emulators.
restrictiveRules.impact: Copying or mirroring another trader, news scalping or a prohibited bot can end the account and cancel the pending reward.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM — all accounts, IP and VPN rules
restrictiveRules.rule: Trading IPs must not match or overlap another user's trading, Trader Area or KYC IP; purchases and KYC through a VPN or VPS are prohibited and the purchase IP country must match the KYC country; dashboard access via VPN/VPS is not allowed; multi-trader households must be declared. Violations 'may lead to payout rejection, restriction, or ban without refund'; undeclared shared IPs 'may result in the termination of all accounts involved'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Sharing an IP with another FTM user, or buying/verifying through a VPN, can cost the payout and every linked account.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM — all accounts, minimum trade holding time
restrictiveRules.rule: In the simulated funded phase, profits from trades closed in under 1 minute are voided and do not count toward the performance reward (no breach). In the challenge phase, if more than 20% of the combined profit target comes from trades held under 1 minute, the challenge must be redone.
restrictiveRules.impact: Very short trades are deducted from the reward; in evaluation they can force a restart.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM — all accounts, gap and sequential trading
restrictiveRules.rule: Opening positions within 5 minutes before rollover and closing them within 5 minutes after is not permitted and those profits are ineligible for rewards. Sequential trading across accounts is not allowed: the same pair may be opened on several accounts only within 5 minutes, otherwise only after the first position is fully closed (official FTM Trade Copier exempt if all positions close together); in the challenge, over 20% of the combined target from violating trades requires a redo. Martingale/layering across accounts counts as sequential trading.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits from rollover-gap trades or staggered multi-account entries are removed from the reward calculation.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM — all accounts, partial closes and overnight hedging
restrictiveRules.rule: Overnight holding is permitted only while 100% of the position is still open; once part is closed, the remainder must be closed the same trading day, and violations cause profits to be deducted (positions on one instrument opened within 15 minutes are aggregated). Overnight hedging is not allowed on Instant Funded or Evaluation Simulated Funded accounts: profits from overnight hedged positions are not counted toward the reward. Overnight and weekend holding is otherwise allowed in all programmes.
restrictiveRules.impact: A partially closed position carried overnight, or an overnight hedge on a funded account, reduces the reward.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM — funded and instant accounts, qualifying trading days
restrictiveRules.rule: Five trading days are required for payout eligibility in the simulated funded phase of 1-Step Nitro and 2-Step Plus and on Instant Standard, Pro and Plus; 2-Step Plus also requires three trading days in each evaluation phase. 'Only trading days with at least 0.5% profit count' toward these requirements. 1-Step Infinity has no minimum.
restrictiveRules.impact: The first reward cannot be requested before five days each closing at least 0.5% in profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: If there is no activity on an account for 30 consecutive calendar days, FTM 'has the right to automatically terminate the simulated trading account for all phases'; planned absences can be approved if notified in advance.
restrictiveRules.impact: An account left idle for 30 days can be closed.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM Instant Standard, Pro and Plus — 15% consistency
restrictiveRules.rule: 'You should not have made more than 15% of the total profit in one day'; if a day exceeds 15%, 'you will have to continue trading until there isn't a day with more than 15%' before a withdrawal.
restrictiveRules.impact: A single strong day delays the reward until total profit grows to about 6.7 times that day's profit.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM Instant Standard and Instant Pro — split ramp
restrictiveRules.rule: The profit split starts at 50/50 for the 1st reward, then 60/40 for the 2nd, 70/30 for the 3rd, and 'remains 80/20 split from the 4th reward onwards'. The pricing page shows 'Up to 80%'.
restrictiveRules.impact: The first three rewards pay the trader 50%, 60% and 70%, below the advertised 80%.

restrictiveRules.rule: Floating loss is limited to 1% of the account balance at all times; 'If floating loss reaches or exceeds this limit, all positions auto-close and the profit split is reduced': 80/20 to 50/50, then 40/60, 30/70, and permanently 20/80 on the fourth breach, including when trades close past the limit because of delays or slippage.
restrictiveRules.impact: Small floating losses, well inside the 6% overall limit, can permanently cut the trader's share to 20%.

restrictiveRules.program: FTM Instant Standard and Instant Pro — full withdrawals only
restrictiveRules.rule: 'Partial Withdrawal is Not allowed' on Instant Standard and Instant Pro accounts; after a full withdrawal the overall drawdown limit resets to its initial-balance level.
restrictiveRules.impact: Traders cannot leave part of the profit in the account as a cushion when requesting a reward.

Terms 4.I.1 apply the 90% only 'up until 10,000 USD' across all evaluation funded accounts on one email. The pricing page shows 'Up to 90%'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits above $10,000 (counted per email across accounts) are paid at 80%.

restrictiveRules.impact: A name or wallet mismatch can cancel an earned reward, and crypto payouts lose 5%.

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. The pricing pages list 1-Step Nitro (5K to 300K, list prices $80 to $1,622 before the site-wide NOV discount; 10% target, 4% daily, 6% trailing limit locking at break-even after 6% profit), 2-Step Plus (8% and 5% targets, 4% daily, 10% static limit, 70% split), and Instant Standard, Pro and Plus (3% daily; 5%, 3% and 6% trailing limits); only the 100K size of the last four rendered. The heaviest conditions are: profits from trades closed in under one minute are voided; best-day ratios of 50%/45% on Nitro and 15% on Instant accounts; Instant Standard and Pro splits of 50%, 60% and 70% before 80% from the 4th reward; a 1% floating-loss Shield on 2-Step Plus and Instant Plus that cuts the split step by step to a permanent 20%; the 90% Nitro split limited to the first $10,000 per email; IP-overlap and VPN rules that can cost payouts and linked accounts; 30-day inactivity closure. The terms name Formed Technologies INT FZCO (UAE) as contracting entity, prohibit using a different strategy on the funded account, and allow blocking a trader 'for any reason'. restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Instant Standard and Instant Pro — 1% maximum open risk
restrictiveRules.rule: 'You must not risk more than 1% of your account balance at any given time', counted across all open trades and scaled positions. The Instant Standard rules state 'Breaching any rule will result in account termination'; the Instant Pro rules state that breaching risk rules results in account termination.
restrictiveRules.impact: Open risk above 1% of balance ends the instant account, well before the 5% overall limit.

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Instant Standard — news and weekend
restrictiveRules.rule: News trading is not allowed and weekend trading is not allowed on Instant Standard; the same article states 'Breaching any rule will result in account termination'.
restrictiveRules.impact: A trade around a news release or held over the weekend can end the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Weekend trading is not allowed on Instant Standard, and 'Breaching any rule will result in account termination'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Positions must be closed before the weekend or the account can be terminated.

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Instant Pro — consistency, profitable days and buffer
restrictiveRules.rule: Each 10-day payout cycle requires 10 trading days, 10 profitable days of at least 0.25%, a 10% profit threshold and 10% consistency (no single day above 10% of total profit); a 5% buffer of account size must stay in the account and cannot be withdrawn. 'All conditions reset for each payout cycle.'
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout needs at least ten separate profitable days and evenly spread profit; the first 5% of profit is never withdrawable while the account is open.

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Instant Pro — 20% cap and 50% split
restrictiveRules.rule: Withdrawals are limited to '20% of account balance per cycle', applied after the 5% buffer and before the 50% profit split (worked example: $30,000 profit on 100K gives the trader $10,000). Excess profit stays for later cycles.
restrictiveRules.impact: Large gains are paid out over several 10-day cycles, at half of the eligible amount.

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Instant Pro — news and weekend profit deductions
restrictiveRules.rule: No opening or closing of trades (including pending orders and SL/TP) from 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after red-folder events; holding over the weekend is not allowed. 'Violating any restriction will result in profit deductions, not account termination'; losses from violating trades are not reinstated.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Holding trades over the weekend is not allowed' and trades must be closed before the weekend; any profit from weekend trades is deducted. Overnight holding is allowed.

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Instant Standard and Instant Pro — minimum trading days

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Forex 1 Phase — funded consistency and news add-on
restrictiveRules.rule: No consistency rule in evaluation; a 50% consistency rule applies in the funded phase, and payout requests require 'All trading rules ... (including the Consistency Rule and Max Loss Limit)' to be followed. 'News trading is only allowed with the add-on' on challenge and funded accounts.

restrictiveRules.program: TX3 Forex Flex — funded floating-loss limit
restrictiveRules.rule: On the funded account, combined floating loss across open positions may not exceed 0.5% of the initial balance at any time (not applied in evaluation). The article does not state the consequence of a breach; the funded account also has a 2.5% daily drawdown.

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. DirectFundedTrader, operated by DFT GROUP LLC at a Dubai address per its Terms, sells four demo programmes: a 2-phase Evaluation (8% and 5% targets, 5% daily and 10% overall loss, 5 days per phase, 1:100), Turbo (started for $9.99 with the rest paid after passing; 6% target, 3% / 8%, 2 days), Fast Funding Standard (10% target, 4% / 7%, no weekend holding) and Instant Funding (3% / 6%, 2% single-trade loss, 30% consistency). Per-size list prices are not shown in the official configurator; DFT50 and DFT99 offers are displayed. The FAQ disables accounts for trades closed in under 60 seconds, for a funded trade without a stop-loss after 30 seconds and for a changed MT5 master password; it bans HFT, arbitrage, tick scalping, grid/martingale, "one-sided betting" and copying others without warning, requires funded trades closed 5 minutes around high-impact news and 3 trades a week, lists seven restricted countries including the UAE, and asks for proof before using other IPs or a VPS. Rewards start after four trading weeks, then every 14 days, with a $100 minimum and only if the cycle ends in profit; the FAQ sets an 80% default rising to 100% after five consecutive rewards, while the home page ties 100/80/70% to the payout frequency. Terms sections 3 and 15 allow termination at the firm's discretion and without notice, and fees are non-refundable once trading starts. Unverified: prices by size, the funded agreement, governing law and independent payout evidence.

set.auditSummary: Priority desk audit (17 November 2026) from Upcomers' official checkout, CFD payout schedule, Horizon and Odyssey specifications, reset-penalty help and full terms. Sizes up to $2 million are advertised as simulated accounts, not deposits or actual trading capital. A transient indexed checkout snapshot advertised $1 million for about $689; the alleged EUR 200 deal was not substantiated at checkout and offers vary by variant and promotion. Horizon $1M: 9% evaluation target, 3% daily and 6% trailing equity risk shield, 80% funded split, 1.5% maximum single-trade loss, at least five profitable funded days each earning 0.5% of nominal account value, then at least 3% ($30,000) profit between payout requests, ordinarily every 14 days. The standard CFD/Perpetuals payout table caps the first $1M withdrawal at $5,000 gross, with product-specific exceptions prevailing. Payment processing fees: bank $19.90 plus 2.49%, and crypto $19.90 plus 30% unless the stated cryptocurrency-order exception applies. A risk-team violation reset, rule-based rejected payout or partially approved violation payout can permanently halve later payouts for that account; this is distinct from the normal tier cap. The advertised BOGO bonus account is awarded only after the purchased account's first payout is fully approved. VPN/VPS is allowed but can trigger manual location scrutiny. Its terms cite a $1.5M aggregate allocation ceiling even while individual program pages show $2M sizes, requiring written clarification. The pre-existing Trustpilot withheld-score/fake-review warning remains, and firm-published $11.1M+ transfers are not third-party bank verification. No account, order, spread, slippage or reward receipt was independently tested.

set.verdict: Forexive's headline Instant access and on-demand payouts need to be read alongside substantial eligibility tests: a tight 3% overall loss limit, 1% maximum per trade, 20% consistency and seven genuinely profitable days. News, EA and inactive-account rules can remove otherwise earned gains or end eligibility. The Trustpilot rating-withheld and fake-review notice previously recorded adds a separate transparency concern. Promotional rates should not outweigh the actual funded-stage restrictions.
set.auditSummary: 17 November 2026 official-FAQ desk audit, separated by evaluation/funded and Instant programs. Instant: 2% daily loss, 3% maximum total drawdown, 1% maximum loss per trade, 20% consistency (one best day not more than a fifth of profits), seven qualifying profitable days of at least 0.5% and at least 3% total profit before any on-demand withdrawal. The first Instant reward split is 70%, then 80%, subject to terms. Evaluation news trades may be allowed, but on funded 1-Step/2-Step accounts profits from positions closed within five minutes before/after high-impact news can be removed even if entries were earlier or closed by stop/take-profit, while losses remain; on Instant, opening or closing in that window is a hard breach. Fully automated trading EAs are not accepted: only approved risk/trade management tools may be used. Published 1-Step/2-Step funded rules also describe 3% floating-loss exposure and account failure after 15 days without trading; certain IP changes may trigger scrutiny. The broad Rules page still contains 'News trading to be confirmed' despite more specific FAQ text, so plan terms need confirmation. Trustpilot already displays a withheld score and removed-fake-reviews notice, preserved from the previous review. PropRadar has not tested live spreads, slippage, execution or any bank-level payout.

restrictiveRules.rule: On funded accounts "any profit made on a trade closed between 5 minutes before and 5 minutes after a high-impact news event" is deducted and does not count toward rewards; losses still count; the account does not fail.
restrictiveRules.impact: Gains on trades closed around high-impact news (including by stop-loss or take-profit) are removed from the payout.

restrictiveRules.rule: "Trading during high-impact economic news is prohibited on Instant Funding accounts": opening or closing any trade, including pending orders and SL/TP executions, within 5 minutes before or after red-folder news is a violation; "If any rules are violated, the trader will not be able to withdraw or request a reward on profits."
restrictiveRules.impact: One trade closed in the news window can cost the right to withdraw the account's profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: No trade may risk or lose more than 1% of the initial balance; "If an open trade goes past that limit at any moment, the account is breached, even if the trade later recovers." Only one trade may be open at a time.
restrictiveRules.impact: A single trade that floats past a 1% loss ends the Instant account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Open positions must never show an unrealised loss of 3% or more of balance or equity; reaching it is a violation even if the trades later recover. The consequence is not stated in that answer.
restrictiveRules.impact: Total open risk is limited to under 3% at any moment, separately from the daily and overall loss limits.

restrictiveRules.rule: The best day must be at most 20% of total profit ("(biggest winning day ÷ current total account profit) × 100%"); failing it blocks rewards until the score is back under 20% or total profit reaches five times the biggest day.
restrictiveRules.impact: A strong single day delays the payout until more profit is made.

restrictiveRules.rule: On-demand reward only after "at least 7 profitable trading days, with each day achieving a minimum of 0.5% profit", at least 3% account profit, no rule breach since the start and completed KYC.
restrictiveRules.impact: No payout until seven qualifying profitable days and 3% total profit are reached.

restrictiveRules.rule: Funded accounts require a minimum of "7 days before first reward".
restrictiveRules.impact: The first payout waits at least seven trading days.

restrictiveRules.rule: Only third-party EAs that manage risk (SL/TP/size) are allowed, after emailing support; any other type, "especially one that executes trades autonomously", leads to "the denial of your evaluation or reward and the closure of your account." Copying trades to or from another trader closes all accounts involved with no money returned.
restrictiveRules.impact: A trade-executing EA or copy trading with another person forfeits the reward and closes the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Tick scalping is limited to 20% of trades closed within one minute; at the funded stage profits from such trades are removed.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits from very short trades beyond the allowance are excluded from rewards.

restrictiveRules.rule: Prohibited practices include HFT, latency, reverse and gap trading, arbitrage, "one-sided betting" and using limit orders to guarantee profits in low liquidity (terms not defined); "Any violation of these rules may result in immediate action, including profit removal", suspension or permanent termination.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits can be removed or the account terminated under broadly worded practices such as one-sided betting, applied by the firm.

restrictiveRules.rule: Not logging in and executing a trade for 15 consecutive days marks the account inactive and the system classifies it as failed (a new account can be requested within 6 months of purchase only if no trades were placed).
restrictiveRules.impact: A 15-day break in trading fails the account, shorter than the 30-day threshold common elsewhere.

restrictiveRules.rule: "You cannot open or close trades between Saturday 00:00 and Sunday 23:59 (broker time)", including SL/TP closes of earlier trades; all crypto activity is prohibited in that window.
restrictiveRules.impact: Weekend crypto trading and weekend SL/TP executions are not allowed.

restrictiveRules.rule: Traders are advised to use "a single IP address"; travel needs advance notice; a breach leads to a warning and profit deduction plus an account reset if profitable, and severe cases to termination without profit share.
restrictiveRules.impact: Unannounced IP changes can cost profits and reset the account.

set.verdict: Alpine Funded now sells an Alpine Pass subscription alongside evaluated and instant models, so its former blanket '21 days then biweekly' payout description was misleading. The Pass requires recurring fees, ten qualifying profit days and a 10% milestone, and rewards are fixed by subscription tier with a $40 processing charge. The company publishes payout certificates, but they are not independently matched to receiving accounts. A previously reported Ukrainian regulator watchlist entry remains an important due-diligence item.
set.auditSummary: Official-source update dated 17 November 2026. Alpine Funded publishes three materially distinct offerings: Alpine Pass recurring subscription, Base Camp instant and Alpine 2-Step. Alpine Pass pricing appears at EUR119/month Standard, EUR189/month Advanced and EUR429/month Pro; advertised nominal account size and absence of conventional drawdown do not mean unlimited cash access. Under Pass, a reward needs a +10% milestone and ten profitable days each at least 0.5%; the top trading day must not exceed 30% of the target. Pass rewards are tiered fixed amounts rather than a uniform profit-share entitlement; the FAQ says Thursday processing for submissions before Tuesday 12:00 UTC, with a $40 fee. This needs clarification against the homepage's broader 'within 24 hours or +$500' reward marketing, and against older help describing 21 days before the first payment while the newer homepage says every 14 days on Alpine 2-Step. A dated collection of payout certificates is displayed on the provider's homepage, but PropRadar has not verified bank transfers, real execution, spreads, KYC eligibility or the recipient. The previously documented 2025 report of a Ukrainian NSSMC watchlist inclusion is retained as reported, not restated as a regulator finding independently read today. Trustpilot's public aggregate and individual testimonials are contextual signals, not proof of payment reliability.

set.verdict: Lvlup Futures sells one-step futures evaluations in two forms: Lvlup accounts (80% split, activation fee after passing, payouts every 14 days capped at 10% of the balance) and Starter accounts (100% split, at most five payouts capped at $1,000-$3,000). set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. Lvlup Futures, operated by LVLUP One UG (haftungsbeschränkt) in Stralsund, Germany (HRB 23184), sells one-step futures evaluations whose assessments are "offered and conducted exclusively by Prop Account, LLC"; funded accounts need a separate Trader Agreement with that company. Lvlup accounts (25K-150K, list $194-$714 one-time or $117-$476 per month) carry a 5% EOD trailing drawdown that locks at the starting balance after 6% profit, no daily loss limit, 5 minimum trading days, a 40% best-day consistency rule checked at each payout, an activation fee after passing, an 80% split and payouts every 14 days capped at 10% of the starting balance. Starter accounts (list $129-$324, no activation fee) run 30 days from the first trade, pay 100% but only up to 50% of profit per request within a $1,000-$3,000 cap, lock during a pending payout and close permanently after the fifth payout. The rules page caps contracts by size and total allocation at $1,000,000, requires positions flat by 15:55 CST and over weekends, allows news trading and own bots, and makes HFT, cross-account hedging, copying between people, group trading, arbitrage and account sharing a Hard Breach; "all-in trading" and strategy switching are prohibited without numeric thresholds, and activity may be reviewed before funding or payout. Unverified: the Client Terms hosted by the evaluation provider (not read), the provider's jurisdiction, and independent payout evidence.

changelog.summary: Firm added to PropRadar. Programs, prices (list prices before the NOV26 coupon), EOD trailing drawdown, 40% consistency rule, 14-day payout cycle and the legal footer read on the official site. Score 56, watchlist: named German brand entity and clear rules, but a brand registered in January 2026, evaluations sold by a separate company (Prop Account, LLC) and no independent payout evidence yet. Lvlup Futures contacted PropRadar about an affiliate program; there is no active affiliation and this has no effect on the score.
Trustpilot: 4.2 from 13 reviews, no notice.
Restrictive-rules audit: read the rules page, FAQ and Elite page; 12 rules across the Lvlup and Starter accounts.

Deep official-source review (pricing, FAQ/help centre and terms): 3 new restrictive rules; 2 programmes; list prices by account size; payout and trading terms; sourced verdict and audit summary replacing the watchlist text. restrictiveRules.rule: Starter accounts allow at most 5 payouts: 'After the fifth approved payout, the Starter Account closes permanently and the journey ends.'
restrictiveRules.impact: The funded Starter account ends by design after five payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: Each Starter payout request may include up to 50% of generated profit and cannot exceed the size cap: $1,000 (25K), $2,000 (50K), $2,500 (100K), $3,000 (150K); minimum about $500. A request above the eligible amount 'may be rejected or adjusted'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Only part of the profit can be withdrawn per request, within a fixed dollar cap.

restrictiveRules.rule: Lvlup funded payouts are capped at 10% of the original starting balance per request: $2,500 (25K), $5,000 (50K), $10,000 (100K), $15,000 (150K), every 14 days.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit above the cap stays in the account until a later cycle.

restrictiveRules.rule: A 40% consistency rule (best day / total accumulated profit) is checked when a payout request is submitted; exceeding it 'does not automatically breach or close the account'.
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout waits until the best day falls to 40% or less of total profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: Starter accounts apply the 40% consistency rule during the evaluation only; there is no consistency rule once funded.
restrictiveRules.impact: Constrains how the evaluation is passed; no effect on funded payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: The funded account keeps a 5% EOD trailing drawdown based on the highest end-of-day balance, locking at the original starting balance once the account reaches 6% profit; 'A payout does not reset drawdown.'
restrictiveRules.impact: Until the lock, end-of-day gains raise the breach level on the funded account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Maximum contracts on total aggregated exposure: 1 E-mini / 10 micros (25K), 3 / 30 (50K), 6 / 60 (100K), 9 / 90 (150K); total allocation capped at $1,000,000 per trader across all accounts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Position size is capped by account size.

restrictiveRules.rule: Positions and pending orders must be closed or cancelled by 15:55 CST on standard days, and 'Positions cannot be carried over the weekend.'
restrictiveRules.impact: No overnight or weekend holding.

restrictiveRules.rule: Evaluations need at least 5 trading days ('Reaching the Profit Target alone does not complete the Evaluation'); Starter funded payouts need a '5 Profitable Trading Day Reward Cycle'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Sets a minimum number of days before passing (and, on Starter, before each payout).

restrictiveRules.rule: HFT, including HFT bots and 'extremely high-frequency order activity', is prohibited; trades 'may not be copied or mirrored between accounts owned by different people'; cross-account hedging is prohibited. Prohibited-trading violations are a Hard Breach that closes the account, which 'cannot be reset, restored or reactivated'.
restrictiveRules.impact: HFT or copying between different people's accounts ends the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: At least one executed trade is required every 30 days in both evaluation and funded stages; the timer cannot be paused.
restrictiveRules.impact: The account must be traded at least monthly; the page read does not detail the consequence.

restrictiveRules.rule: Prohibited conduct includes 'All-in trading and excessive leverage' and 'manipulative strategy switching' (trading must reflect a genuine strategy, not a temporary high-risk method used to pass), without numeric thresholds; listed penalties include termination, loss of funded or payout eligibility and forfeiture of profit, and trading activity 'may be reviewed before Funded approval or payout processing'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits can be forfeited on the firm's assessment of risk-taking or strategy changes.

restrictiveRules.rule: Starter evaluations run for a fixed 30-day period from the first executed trade and do not renew; Lvlup accounts have no fixed expiry date.
restrictiveRules.impact: A Starter evaluation not passed within 30 days of its first trade ends without a funded account.

restrictiveRules.rule: The Starter account is locked while a payout request is pending and unlocks once the payout is approved.
restrictiveRules.impact: No trading is possible between a Starter payout request and its approval.

restrictiveRules.rule: Prohibited activity also includes exploiting delayed feeds, incorrect quotes, platform errors or latency, front-running, arbitrage between Lvlup accounts or with other firms, coordinated group or signal trading, third-party passing, account sharing and trading on insider information; listed outcomes include suspension, termination, loss of funded or payout eligibility, forfeiture of profit and loss of fees, and prohibited trading is a Hard Breach that closes the account.
restrictiveRules.impact: Any of these practices can end the account and cancel profits.

restrictiveRules.program: All accounts purchased on or after 1 October 2026 (Evaluation, Sim Funded, Live Funded)
restrictiveRules.rule: Accounts purchased on or after October 1, 2026 "will be permanently closed if no trade is executed for 14 consecutive calendar days". An extension can be requested in advance, but "approval is discretionary" and accounts closed for inactivity "cannot be reopened".
restrictiveRules.impact: Two weeks without a trade ends the account, including a funded one, with no reopening; a planned absence depends on a discretionary extension.

restrictiveRules.rule: The pricing card lists a "Retained Buffer $3,000" and "First Payout Up to $2,500". The knowledgebase describes the Protected Buffer as "a minimum balance that cannot be withdrawn" while the trader progresses toward a Live Funded Account.
restrictiveRules.impact: The first withdrawal is capped and part of the profit must stay in the account until the Live Funded stage.

restrictiveRules.program: Instant Funded and 100K Pioneer — payout eligibility
restrictiveRules.rule: The pricing cards list a "Payout qualification target" together with minimum days (10 on Instant Funded, 7 on Pioneer) and minimum profitable days ("5 × $200+" on 50k, "5 × $125+" on 25k, "5 × $300+" on Pioneer). Trading and profitable days are counted midnight to midnight ET.
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout needs both a profit threshold and a set number of qualifying days, so the first withdrawal cannot come before those days are completed.

restrictiveRules.program: Sim Funded to Live Funded transition
restrictiveRules.rule: Live Funded Accounts require brokerage onboarding, identity verification and compliance approval; "Final approval decisions are made entirely by the brokerage and compliance teams. Purdia Capital does not control, influence, or override these determinations." Payouts taken from the interim Temp Sim Funded Account "directly reduce the amount of capital ultimately eligible to transfer into the Live Funded Account".
restrictiveRules.impact: Moving to live funding depends on a third-party broker decision the firm says it cannot override, and withdrawing while waiting lowers the live allocation.

restrictiveRules.rule: Prohibited-country restrictions "are determined primarily by our brokerage and compliance partners and may change at any time without prior notice. As a result, eligibility may change even after prior approval or account activity."
restrictiveRules.impact: A trader already approved and trading can lose eligibility if the partner list changes; the summary does not say what happens to accrued profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: Purdia uses "automated and manual fraud prevention, payment verification, and compliance review procedures"; accounts "may be temporarily restricted or placed under review" while identity, payment-method ownership or other documents are requested. Payouts are processed manually on business days and timing can vary with "compliance review".
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout can be delayed while an account is under review; no maximum review time is stated in the summary.

restrictiveRules.rule: "Purdia Capital permits only one user account per individual and per household." Accounts may not be shared, transferred, operated for another person or used to circumvent household limits. Traders may run up to three accounts at once across all stages.
restrictiveRules.impact: Two traders living at the same address cannot each hold a user account; the summary does not state the consequence of a breach.

restrictiveRules.rule: Semi-automated trading and trade copiers are permitted if the trader "remains actively involved"; "Fully automated 'set-and-forget' trading systems that operate without active trader oversight are not permitted."
restrictiveRules.impact: Unattended bots are excluded; the line between semi- and fully-automated is not defined.

restrictiveRules.rule: "The primary prohibited practice is hedging between highly correlated positions or accounts." Traders "may not attempt to exploit technical issues, platform behavior, or operational loopholes."
restrictiveRules.impact: Correlated hedges across accounts are barred; the consequence of a breach is not stated in the summary.

restrictiveRules.rule: "all positions and working orders are automatically closed prior to the daily market close."

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. Klein Funding (brand "Klein Funding Crypto") sells a 1-Step evaluation (3% daily / 6% overall loss, at least 4 trading days) and a 2-Step evaluation (4% / 8%), both with a static drawdown, no time limit and simulated sizes up to $6,000 to $100,000 at list prices of $49-$539 (1-Step) and $49-$439 (2-Step) per the official FAQ; profit-target percentages are not given in the text of the pages read. Trading is on TradeLocker (crypto, forex, indices, metals). The FAQ states that profits made within two minutes before or after a red-folder news event are removed as a soft breach, three soft breaches becoming a hard breach; that trading more than one evaluation at a time triggers a warning and then a breach; that hedging, arbitrage, latency, HFT, tick scalping, group trading and holding over half of trades under one minute are prohibited; and that shared households, devices, IPs or VPS are not allowed, with $400,000 of funded capital per trader. The pricing page adds a nightly 11:30-11:59 PM CET reset window with no trading, and it conflicts with the FAQ on minimum days for the 2-Step. Payouts: 70% first share, 85% after (90% with a paid add-on), requested on the 10th and 20th once the funded account is 10 days old, processed in 24-48 hours; the FAQ cites a "no payout denial policy". Fees are non-refundable. Unverified: the Terms of Use (page not reachable), the legal entity, and independent payout evidence.
