restrictiveRules.rule: Profits made within two minutes before or after a high-impact news event (red on ForexFactory) are invalidated and opening or closing trades in that window is not permitted; each case is deducted and counts as a soft breach, and three soft breaches escalate to a hard breach.
restrictiveRules.impact: News-window profit is removed; repeated cases end the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Having more than 50% of trades held for less than one minute is listed among prohibited trading styles. The FAQ does not state the consequence.
restrictiveRules.impact: A short-term scalping profile can be treated as a prohibited style.

restrictiveRules.rule: Arbitrage, latency trading, high-frequency trading, reverse trading/group hedging, tick scalping, order book spamming and group trading are not allowed. The FAQ does not state the consequence.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits from these styles are exposed to review; the sanction is not specified on the FAQ.

restrictiveRules.rule: Operating multiple accounts from the same household, device, IP address or VPS is "strictly prohibited"; VPN use is at the user's risk and IP matches with other users can lead to account restrictions; at most $400,000 of funded capital may be traded from one IP address.
restrictiveRules.impact: Shared or VPN IP addresses can lead to account restrictions.

restrictiveRules.rule: Payouts can be requested only on the 10th and 20th of each month and only after the funded account has been active for at least 10 days; a missed cycle waits for the next one. All trades must be closed before the request, and trading is not possible while a payout is processing.
restrictiveRules.impact: Withdrawals are limited to two fixed dates a month and require a flat account.

restrictiveRules.rule: The first profit share is 70%, later shares 85%; 90% from the first payout only with a paid add-on.
restrictiveRules.impact: The first payout is paid at a lower split than the advertised maximum.

restrictiveRules.rule: "You may trade your Funded Accounts simultaneously, but you may not trade more than one Evaluation at a time." If an account is found trading multiple evaluations at once "a warning will be sent out"; "if the issue repeats, a breach will ensue."
restrictiveRules.impact: Trading two evaluations in parallel a second time breaches the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: "We do not allow hedging within a single trading account, across accounts held by the same trader" (or between traders); opposite positions on different instruments are allowed. The FAQ does not state the consequence.
restrictiveRules.impact: Same-instrument hedging, even inside one account, is a prohibited practice whose sanction is not specified.

restrictiveRules.rule: "you must trade on at least 4 different days for 1 phased evaluations"; a trading day is one with at least one transaction and days need not be consecutive.
restrictiveRules.impact: The 1-Step evaluation cannot be passed in fewer than four trading days.

restrictiveRules.rule: The FAQ says "For 2 phased evaluations, there is no minimum trading days requirement", while the pricing/rules page says traders must trade a set (unstated) number of days during the evaluation and funded stages.
restrictiveRules.impact: Official pages disagree on whether a minimum number of trading days applies to the 2-Step evaluation and funded stage.

restrictiveRules.rule: The daily loss limit resets each day between 11:30 PM and 11:59 PM CET and trading is not allowed during this reset window.
restrictiveRules.impact: A nightly window of about 30 minutes in which no trades can be placed, including on 24/7 crypto markets.

set.auditSummary: Official-source review dated 19 November 2026. The pricing pages list MAX Standard ($148-$658, 25K-250K, five trading days of $150+, 40% consistency in evaluation and funded, 50K rules: $3,000 target, $1,250 daily loss, $2,000 EOD drawdown) and STEADY ($149-$750, two winning days, no daily loss limit, 52% consistency in evaluation only, EOD trailing drawdown from $1,200 to $5,500). The heaviest conditions are the live review that closes all sim accounts after 4 payouts on one MAX account or 10 since the last review, the STEADY live review after 5 payouts, per-payout caps ($1,000 then $1,250 on MAX 50K; $1,000-$3,000 by size on STEADY) with a $10,000 per-user ceiling, a hedging ban that ends funding eligibility, a 5-account copy-trading limit, closure by 4:50pm EST, a T1 news blackout on funded stages and a help-centre inactivity rule cancelling accounts with fewer than 3 qualifying days in 29 days. The FAQ states an 80/20 split on Sim Funded Pro and 90/10 on Institution accounts, and same-day payout requests once eligible. Official pages disagree on news trading, automation and the Buy 1 Get 1 offer for STEADY. The Terms of Use (Termly), risk disclosure and most help-centre articles could not be read, and payout evidence was not audited.

restrictiveRules.rule: 50K funded payouts are capped at $1,000 for payouts 1-3 and $1,250 from payout 4; across all accounts a user may withdraw at most '$10,000 per payout'; minimum payout $500.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit above the cap waits for later payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: 40% consistency rule on the funded account (also in evaluation); it resets per account after a withdrawal, but best-day P&L never resets.
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout waits until no single day exceeds 40% of profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: A live review is triggered 'After 4 payouts on one account or 10 since the last live review'; on live review 'All sim accounts close'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Sim funded accounts end by design after a set number of payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: The funded account keeps the end-of-day trailing drawdown ($2,000 on 50K), which 'Locks at starting balance + $100'.
restrictiveRules.impact: The funded loss limit rises with end-of-day gains until it locks.

restrictiveRules.rule: Copy trading is limited to 5 accounts; exceeding it on the same product means 'none of the accounts that took that trade will be eligible for funding'. Automation is allowed only 'at the discretion of FFN'; HFT bots or exploiting the sim lead to losing account access.
restrictiveRules.impact: Copying to too many accounts or using HFT bots can cost funding or the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Hedging (including mini/micro and long/short across the ES/MES/NQ/MNQ family) is a broken rule that makes the trader 'no longer eligible for funding'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Opposite positions on related contracts can end funding eligibility.

restrictiveRules.rule: Tier-1 news (FOMC, FOMC Minutes, NFP, CPI): traders must be flat from 1 minute before to 1 minute after the release; Financial Juice is the only accepted calendar. News trading is allowed in the evaluation.
restrictiveRules.impact: Constrains trading around major releases.

restrictiveRules.rule: All positions must be closed by 4:50pm EST.
restrictiveRules.impact: No holding positions through the daily close.

restrictiveRules.rule: Minimum 5 trading days of $150+ each to pass (50K).
restrictiveRules.impact: Sets a minimum pace to pass.

restrictiveRules.rule: The FAQ states: 'All final decisions are at the sole discretion of FFN.'
restrictiveRules.impact: Rule disputes, including payout decisions, are settled at the firm's discretion.

restrictiveRules.rule: Funded accounts first build a buffer equal to the drawdown; 'per-payout caps start at $1,000-$3,000 by size and rise from your 4th payout'; withdrawals across all accounts are capped at $10,000 per payout.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit above the per-payout cap waits for later payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'After 5 payouts your account goes to live review.'
restrictiveRules.impact: The simulated funded account ends by design after five payouts and moves to a live review.

restrictiveRules.rule: Evaluation only: no single day may exceed 52% of total profit; the page states there is no consistency rule once funded.
restrictiveRules.impact: A large winning day can delay passing the evaluation; no effect on funded payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: Minimum 2 winning days to pass, with a minimum winning day of $100 (25K) to $350 (250K).
restrictiveRules.impact: Sets a minimum pace to pass.

restrictiveRules.rule: 50K funded contract scaling by profit: 2 Mini (20 Micros) at $0-$1,000, 3 Mini (30 Micros) at $1,001-$2,000, 4 Mini (40 Micros) from $2,001; maximum 4 Mini (40 Micros).
restrictiveRules.impact: Position size is limited until the funded account builds profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: Help article 6.5: 'you must complete at least 3 qualifying trading days within every 29-day period' (a qualifying day closes with realized P&L of at least $5); 'The requirement applies to all accounts'; otherwise the account 'is automatically cancelled', with no warning or manual review.
restrictiveRules.impact: An account with fewer than three qualifying days in any 29-day window is cancelled.

restrictiveRules.rule: FAQ: 'You can have up to 5 active Sim Funded accounts at one time'; an extra pass 'waits in your queue' until a slot opens.
restrictiveRules.impact: Limits how many funded accounts can trade at once.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms 11.1: the Funded Trader offer is at the Company's sole discretion, and paying the fee or passing does not oblige an offer. 12.2 prohibits any strategy the Company considers not to represent trading in good faith; under 12.3 a breach allows suspension or termination without notice and the trader "will forfeit any fees or payments you are entitled to". 18.2: the Company may terminate "for any reason and without cause at any time".
restrictiveRules.impact: Earned trader payments can be forfeited on the firm's own assessment of 'good faith' trading, and a passed evaluation does not guarantee a funded account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms clause 19.3: when a single trade "contributes more than 50% to their overall win", the worked example removes that trade's profit from the withdrawable amount ($10,000 total win, $5,000 trade removed). Clause 19.2: trades opened within 30 seconds are combined and "The 50% rule also would apply directly to the combined trades".
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit from one dominant trade (or a cluster opened within 30 seconds) can be excluded from the payout.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms clause 19.1: an average lot size is computed over the whole trading history; the allowed range is that average plus 100% to minus 75%, and "The profitable trades that fall outside the trade range will be removed". In the funded phase, simultaneous trades on the same pair are treated as one aggregate position.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profitable trades sized well above or below the trader's own average are deducted from the withdrawable profit.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms clause 19.3 states traders need "a minimum of 5 trading days".
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout cannot be reached in fewer than five trading days.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms clause 18.1: if you "do not use or access your Account or the Trading Platform for 6 consecutive months", the Company may treat this as discontinuation and close or restrict the account; 18.1(e) says a Funded Trader still receives remaining earned Trader Payments.
restrictiveRules.impact: An account left unused for six months can be closed.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms clause 8.3: a user linked to a card dispute or chargeback is blacklisted; for withdrawals the Company may decline the request and suspend the account, with exceptions at its "sole discretion". Clause 8.2: unsubstantiated chargebacks may make the trader liable for the Company's costs, including legal costs on a full indemnity basis.
restrictiveRules.impact: Any card dispute linked to the trader can lead to a refused withdrawal and a suspended account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms clause 11.3: onboarding as a Funded Trader may require further checks including "criminal history and bankruptcy checks and bank account information"; under clause 4 (residency) monies paid are non-refundable if the trader breaches the residency representations, and the Company may suspend or terminate without notice for sanctions compliance.
restrictiveRules.impact: The funded stage, and so any payout, depends on checks beyond identity, and a residency breach forfeits fees.

restrictiveRules.rule: High-impact news trading is restricted on all programmes except Sprint: traders 'may not open, increase, fully close, or partially close a position within five minutes before or five minutes after' a high-impact event, including pending orders that trigger in the window. 'A breach may result in removal of affected profits, an account repeat, restriction or termination of the account.'
restrictiveRules.impact: A trade opened or closed (including by a stop or take-profit) inside the 10-minute window can lead to removal of the profits concerned or account termination.

restrictiveRules.program: Turbo, ONE and Instant Rewards accounts
restrictiveRules.rule: At a reward request, 'your highest single trading day's profit must not exceed 20% of your total accumulated profit'; otherwise the trader must keep trading until the score falls to 20% or below.
restrictiveRules.impact: A strong single day delays the reward request until enough further profit is made; the account is not breached.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Your first two rewards are each capped at 10% of your account size.' From the third reward onward there is no cap.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit above 10% of the account size cannot be withdrawn in each of the first two reward requests.

restrictiveRules.program: Turbo, ONE and Instant Rewards accounts
restrictiveRules.rule: The Rewards account keeps a 6% maximum trailing drawdown (Turbo and ONE programme tables; Instant lists a 6% 'Maximum Loss (Equity Trailing)').
restrictiveRules.impact: The loss limit follows account highs on the funded stage, so withdrawable profit can be lost to a smaller pullback than under a static limit.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Repetitive micro-duration trading' and tick scalping are prohibited; 'positions are expected to remain open for at least two minutes', described as a benchmark. Listed responses to prohibited conduct include 'Removal of affected profits', 'Reward denial' and 'Account termination', and 'Not every case is handled the same way.'
restrictiveRules.impact: Short trades are judged case by case against a two-minute benchmark that is not a hard rule, and profits from them can be removed.

restrictiveRules.rule: The prohibited-practices page states 'we may treat as prohibited any conduct that is uncommercial, manipulative, or inconsistent' (also listing 'account churning' and using accounts as 'disposable reward-extraction units'); responses range from profit removal to account termination and 'clear cases may result in immediate action'. The terms (section 8) let the firm decide whether a rule was breached and approve a reward 'for a different amount' or refuse it.
restrictiveRules.impact: Rewards can be reduced or refused under a broadly worded standard applied at the firm's discretion.

restrictiveRules.rule: Prohibited: 'High-frequency trading, tick scalping', 'Signal copying and externally dictated entries or exits', and grid or martingale escalation. The terms (section 7.2) also bar third-party account-management, signal-copying or trade-copying services.
restrictiveRules.impact: Copy-trading, HFT or grid/martingale use can lead to removal of profits, reward denial or account termination.

restrictiveRules.program: Turbo, ONE and Classic Rewards accounts
restrictiveRules.rule: A reward needs at least 3 profitable trading days of 0.5% of the initial balance each; on Turbo the first reward also comes only '14 calendar days after you start trading in your Rewards account'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Sets a minimum time and activity before the first reward can be requested.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'If your account remains inactive for more than 30 days, it will be considered dormant and subsequently closed.'
restrictiveRules.impact: An account with no trade for over 30 days is closed.

addPayoutProofs.quote: The homepage displays '$1 M+' under 'Proven payouts delivered to global traders' and a gallery of payout certificates. These remain company-origin claims without PropRadar-authenticated customer transfers, payment processor receipts or blockchain transaction identifiers.

restrictiveRules.rule: Funded accounts have a restricted news window in which no trade may be opened or closed: 4 minutes (Legacy, Swift), 10 minutes (Flagship), 16 minutes (Instant). USD news restricts all pairs. Profit on such trades "will be deducted upon the payout request"; for excess news profits "the payout will be rejected, your profit share will be forfeited and the account will be reset."
restrictiveRules.impact: Trades in the news window are removed from the payout, and in the stated cases the whole payout and profit share are lost.

restrictiveRules.rule: High-frequency trading and latency arbitrage are "strictly prohibited"; the use of EAs and trade copiers "will lead to evaluation denial, payout denial, and account closure". Copying between Challenge accounts is limited to two accounts; copy trading is not allowed on Instant accounts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Using an EA or trade copier can cost the payout and the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: The IP region must stay consistent; changes may lead the Risk Team to request evidence such as "a plane ticket, passport stamp, or live video". Terms section 6: payouts "may be declined in cases of suspected rule breaches, location discrepancies, or strategy manipulation"; section 8 prohibits using "VPNs to exploit the system".
restrictiveRules.impact: Trading from a different region can delay or block a payout until travel is evidenced.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms section 4: breaches of rules including undefined "prohibited strategies" "may result in disqualification from funding or profit eligibility"; section 6: payouts may be declined for suspected "strategy manipulation"; section 13: the firm may "suspend or terminate any user account without prior notice"; section 9: "remaining balances may be forfeited".
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits can be withheld and accounts closed on grounds the terms do not define.

restrictiveRules.rule: Payouts can be requested "every fourteenth calendar day following the initiation of the first trade on the funded account"; "If you miss the 14th calendar day, you will need to wait another 14 calendar days". Requests must be submitted before 17:00 UK time. On-demand payouts only at VIP Spot.
restrictiveRules.impact: Missing the single request day pushes the payout back by 14 days.

restrictiveRules.rule: 1-Step funded accounts keep a trailing maximum loss of 6% (Legacy, Flagship) or 5% (Swift); Instant trails at 5%, and after a payout request the maximum total loss resets to the initial balance. 2-Step funded accounts use a fixed limit.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profits on the funded account raise the breach level, so a later pullback can end the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: "Traders are not permitted to hold trades over the weekend" on Instant accounts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Positions must be closed before the weekend.

restrictiveRules.rule: An Instant account inactive "for more than 30 days" after the first trade "will be terminated".
restrictiveRules.impact: A 30-day pause ends the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Minimum 2 trading days for most programmes, 3 for 2-Step Flagship.
restrictiveRules.impact: Sets a minimum duration before an evaluation can pass.

restrictiveRules.rule: A stop-loss is mandatory on all trades and 'must be placed within 60 seconds of trade opening' (accounts from 1 December 2025); unprotected trades are auto-closed and each violation is a soft breach.
restrictiveRules.impact: On a funded account a soft breach means profit forfeiture and a balance reset; three soft breaches count as a hard breach that deactivates the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Maximum 2% exposure', risking more than 2% per trade, floating P&L reaching -2% of balance, or more than 3 positions per instrument are prohibited; 'VIOLATIONS WILL RESULT IN A HARD BREACH'.
restrictiveRules.impact: A single trade or open-loss excursion beyond 2% ends the account with no profit withdrawal.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Maximum exposure must not exceed 3% at any time' (from initial balance, or current balance when below it); any violation is a hard breach. A separate layering rule allows at most 4 positions per instrument (soft breach).
restrictiveRules.impact: Exceeding 3% exposure deactivates the account and removes the right to withdraw profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Excessive margin usage is strictly prohibited on all Evaluation and Simulated Funded Accounts'; trades leaving insufficient free margin or showing 'reckless overleveraging' may be deemed excessive after Risk Team review, and 'a confirmed violation will result in a Hard Breach'.
restrictiveRules.impact: No numeric threshold is given; the Risk Team decides, and a confirmed finding ends the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: No new positions or modifications from 3 minutes before to 3 minutes after high-impact (red-folder) news on affected pairs and related indices; tentative news is an all-day restriction. 'Each violation of the news rule will result in a soft breach.' A 'Black Swan' clause lets the risk team invalidate trades at its discretion.
restrictiveRules.impact: On a funded account each violation forfeits profits and resets the balance.

restrictiveRules.rule: Payouts are biweekly 'provided there are no soft breaches on the account' and are accepted only on the trader's assigned payout request day; requests on any other date are automatically rejected. Minimum trading days must be completed again after each account reset.
restrictiveRules.impact: A request on the wrong day is rejected and waits for the next cycle; any soft breach blocks the payout and refund.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'No single day's profits may exceed 20% of total profits'; 4 profitable trading days and a 2% minimum withdrawal amount.
restrictiveRules.impact: A strong single day delays eligibility for a payout until total profits grow.

restrictiveRules.program: Instant Funding and 1 Step — funded stage
restrictiveRules.rule: 1 Step: max drawdown 6% 'trailing from the highest equity or balance (High Water Mark)' on Phase 1 and the Simulated Funded Account. Instant: daily loss 3% and maximum drawdown 6%, both 'trailing HWM'.
restrictiveRules.impact: The loss limit follows the account's peak on the funded account, so earned profit can be lost back before the drawdown floor stops moving.

restrictiveRules.rule: EAs need pre-approval and the trader must own the source code; trade copiers need approval per account; exceeding 5,000 server messages a day is 'hyperactivity'. restrictiveRules.impact: Unapproved or hyperactive automation forfeits funded-account profits.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'All accounts must execute at least one trade within a 30-day period'; accounts inactive for 30 days or more are hard breached and permanently closed, and terminated accounts lose profit withdrawal rights.

restrictiveRules.rule: The first five payouts are capped (before the 80/20 split): first payout 2.5% of account size (e.g. $2,500 on $100K), payouts 2-5 at 3% ($3,000 on $100K); every withdrawal, including partial ones, counts toward the five capped payouts, and 'meeting the conditions does not guarantee approval'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit above the cap stays on the account for later cycles during the first five payouts.

restrictiveRules.rule: From the second payout on, at least 1% of the initial account size in new profit is required since the previous payout (e.g. $1,000 on $100K), plus a 'protected buffer' where applicable; this continues after the fifth payout.
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout cannot be requested until the account has made 1% more since the last one.

restrictiveRules.rule: The trading-objectives page shows consistency 'None' in the Phase 1 and Phase 2 sections, a 50% consistency rule in the $100K calculator, and 'According to selected account rules' for the funded stage; the homepage table lists 50% on payout.
restrictiveRules.impact: A best-day share limit may apply to payouts, but official pages do not agree on it.

restrictiveRules.rule: The programme comparison lists a 30% consistency rule on payout.
restrictiveRules.impact: A large single day relative to total profit can hold back a payout.

restrictiveRules.rule: Instant Funding carries a 20% consistency rule (programme comparison and trading-objectives page).
restrictiveRules.impact: A large single day relative to total profit can hold back a payout.

restrictiveRules.rule: Instant Funding has no evaluation; its 3% daily and 5% total loss limits are described as trailing.
restrictiveRules.impact: The loss floor follows the account's gains on a funded account, so earned profit can be lost back.

restrictiveRules.rule: The Risk Team may reject a payout for 'trading activity that does not align' with its requirements; the terms let the Company 'disallow or block any Trader from participating in the program for any reason' (section 3) and terminate services 'in its sole and absolute discretion and without prior notice' (section 10).
restrictiveRules.impact: Payouts and accounts can be refused on criteria that are not defined in advance.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms section 3 prohibit 'any third-party strategy, off-the-shelf strategy or one marketed to pass challenge accounts', latency/price-error exploitation and arbitrage across accounts; if detected, participation 'will be terminated and may include forfeiture of any fees', and the help centre says the funded account is then 'denied' 'without a refund'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Using a purchased or shared strategy can end the programme at the funding review, with no refund.

restrictiveRules.rule: When an account is flagged as high risk, failing to respond 'within twenty-four (24) hours of said request may result in your use of and access to the Services being revoked' (terms section 6).
restrictiveRules.impact: Missing a 24-hour verification request can end access to the account.

restrictiveRules.program: TenEdge Instant and TenEdge funded stage — profit cap per payout
restrictiveRules.rule: The TenEdge Instant page lists a 'Profit Cap Per Payout' of $100 (Academy) to $10,000 (Legend), i.e. 10% of the account. The TenEdge terms (section 8) add: 'Profit above 10% on Instant/Live funded stage will be forfeited and account reset after payout'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit above 10% of the initial capital in a payout cycle is not paid and does not carry over; the account is reset after each payout.

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms sections 9 and 11 prohibit HFT, latency arbitrage, double-leg (cross-broker hedge) arbitrage, tick scalping, ultra-fast (1-minute) scalping and rapid open/close cycles; evaluation accounts violating this 'will be deleted without any notice', and remedies listed include trade cancellation, payout denial, termination and permanent disqualification. EAs are not allowed on evaluation accounts.
restrictiveRules.impact: Very short-term trading can lead to cancelled trades, a refused payout or loss of the account; the ban on 1-minute scalping is stated only in the terms.

restrictiveRules.rule: The funded-trader overview states that accounts 'remain subject to ongoing compliance monitoring, and reckless, gambling-style behaviour can still void a payout'. The TenEdge terms (section 11) list excessive leverage, 'all-in or jackpot' trading, sudden lot-size increases and 'Attempting to achieve payout targets primarily through one or two trades', with TenTrade keeping 'sole and absolute discretion' to judge violations.
restrictiveRules.impact: A payout can be refused on a judgement about trading behaviour that has no numeric threshold.

restrictiveRules.program: TenExpress Instant — profit cap per payout
restrictiveRules.rule: The plan table lists 'Profit Cap Per Payout: 10%' for every plan (Micro to Master); the page does not say what happens to profit above the cap.
restrictiveRules.impact: Each 15-day payout is limited to 10% of the account size.

restrictiveRules.program: TenExpress Instant and Challenge — profit score
restrictiveRules.rule: The plan tables list 'Profit Score Max (Per Trade/Day): 25%' on every plan; the pages do not state the consequence of exceeding it.
restrictiveRules.impact: No single trade or day may make up more than 25% of profit; exceeding it can affect payout eligibility (consequence not stated on the pages read).

restrictiveRules.rule: Terms section 10: 30 days of inactivity (Instant: 30 days after the first trade) loses the account, which is 'disabled and permanently lost'.
restrictiveRules.impact: An account left untraded for 30 days is closed.

restrictiveRules.program: All funded programmes — minimum trading days
restrictiveRules.rule: Payouts require at least 5 active trading days (10 on TenEdge Challenge Legend and TenExpress Diamond/Master plans).
restrictiveRules.impact: No payout before the minimum number of active days.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Maximum Open Positions' is 5 on all plans (10 on TenExpress Challenge Diamond and Master); the TenEdge terms say the limit is system-enforced.

restrictiveRules.rule: Every opened position needs a stop-loss order. More than five minutes without one automatically breaches the account, while an omission lasting under five minutes still leads to payout rejection and account reset.
restrictiveRules.impact: A briefly omitted stop loss can invalidate a reward even before the five-minute account-breach threshold.

restrictiveRules.program: 1-Phase and 2-Phase funded — trade concentration and risk
restrictiveRules.rule: One trade idea (including overlapping trades counted together) must not exceed 45% of total profit, and its planned stop-loss risk must stay at or below 1% of initial capital. Exceeding the profit ratio rejects the payout and resets the account; exceeding the risk limit can also breach the account.
restrictiveRules.impact: Related orders are combined as one idea, so splitting entries does not bypass either rule.

restrictiveRules.program: Instant Funding — stop loss and concentration
restrictiveRules.rule: The Instant plan requires a stop loss within two minutes, not five; a single trade idea may account for at most 20% of profits at withdrawal. It also uses a 6% trailing maximum-loss rule.
restrictiveRules.impact: The Instant account has materially stricter order-management timing and payout-concentration conditions than 1-Phase/2-Phase funded accounts.

restrictiveRules.program: All funded paths — news and weekends
restrictiveRules.rule: The terms prohibit affected-currency exposure within ten minutes before and after high-impact releases and all open weekend positions; violations can cause payout rejection and account breach.
restrictiveRules.impact: A position that stays open across an announcement or the Friday close can violate the rule even without a new entry in that window.

set.auditSummary: 18 November 2026 detailed review of X Funded's current 1-Phase, 2-Phase and Instant Funding contract. The first two funded plans mandate stop losses within five minutes, cap each combined trade idea at 1% of initial risk and 45% of accrued profit, and restrict news exposure and weekends. Instant imposes a tighter two-minute stop-loss placement requirement, 20% profit concentration and a 6% trailing loss ceiling. Even short stop-loss omissions can cause account reset or reward rejection under the written terms. The earlier audit already noted a 50% base split on affiliate-referred accounts after their first eligible payout and a withheld Trustpilot rating; neither fact is independent proof of a failed payment. The editorial score stays 52/100, with unverified operating history and firm-reported payout totals kept separate from independently authenticated transfers.

changelog.summary: Made existing contract risk clearer programme by programme: five-minute funded versus two-minute Instant stop-loss timing, 45% versus 20% single-trade-idea concentration, 1% trade risk and news/weekend rules. No new incident or change to the 52/100 editorial rating.

Initial 52/100 editorial profile: standard 1-Phase, standard 2-Phase and Instant Funding documented with original euro fees. Legal registrations, founding year, permissions and client payments remain unconfirmed. No earlier score is replaced.

Affiliate-referred accounts have a 50% base profit split after the first approved payout across current and future accounts. The official policy also permits retroactive adjustments and limits the 100% add-on. PropRadar has no affiliation with X Funded.

Trustpilot shows 583 reviews and withholds the TrustScore for a guideline breach, with a review-removal notice. No old rating or invented removal count is used; review status is not treated as a payment failure.
Company-reported payout total captured separately from independently verified transfers. The homepage amount is not used to mark customer payments as authenticated.
Restrictive rules classified under SCORING.md (category, severity, clarity, programmes) so the shared penalty can be computed.

addPayoutProofs.quote: The homepage reports more than $5 million earned by traders globally. This is an undated company total read on 16 November 2026; individual transfers and the aggregate were not independently authenticated.

changelog.summary: Restrictive-rules audit: read the official trading-rules page and the payout guide; 13 rules across the 1 Step and 2 Step Challenges; the two pages disagree on the payout cap.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'All instruments (standard): minimum 2-minute hold time'; XAUUSD, BTCUSD and all indices: 'minimum 5-minute hold time'. Profits from trades closed earlier may be cancelled and deducted from the balance.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit from trades closed before 2 or 5 minutes can be removed.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'The maximum loss attributable to a single trade idea must not exceed 2% of the account's initial balance'; exceeding it is a breach.
restrictiveRules.impact: A single trade idea losing more than 2% of the initial balance can end the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Lot sizes must stay within a consistency range (average lot minus 70% to average plus 100%); profitable trades outside the range 'are excluded from both the payout amount and the account balance'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Profit on trades sized outside the range is removed.

restrictiveRules.rule: A single day's profit may not represent 30% (1 Step) or 40% (2 Step) or more of total account profit; the trader must keep trading until the highest day falls below the limit. The limits continue after funding and do not reset after payouts.
restrictiveRules.impact: A large winning day delays the payout until further profit is made.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Any single trade generating more than 15% of total profits triggers a soft breach'; 'accumulating 4 soft breaches results in a hard breach and account disqualification'.
restrictiveRules.impact: Repeated large single trades can lead to disqualification of the funded account.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'A Stop Loss must be set within 60 seconds of opening any trade'; missing this deadline 'results in a hard breach'. The trading-rules page does not state this requirement.
restrictiveRules.impact: A trade left without a stop-loss for over 60 seconds can end the account.

restrictiveRules.rule: The trading-rules page states 'The maximum gain eligible for profit split in any single payout period is 6% of the funded account starting balance'; the payout guide states 'No payout size cap applies.'
restrictiveRules.impact: Gains above 6% per period may be excluded from a payout; the two official pages disagree.

restrictiveRules.rule: First payout eligible '15 calendar days after the first trade is placed'; a minimum of 10 active trading days and 6 profitable trading days (0.5% of initial balance each) is required before a request; all positions must be closed.
restrictiveRules.impact: Sets a minimum period and activity before each payout request.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'During the funded stage, all automated strategies, trade copiers, and scripted systems are strictly prohibited'; trading in synchronisation with other accounts or mirroring is listed as prohibited behaviour, with consequences including profit removal, closure or permanent ban.
restrictiveRules.impact: Strategies that passed the challenge with an EA cannot be run on the funded account.

restrictiveRules.rule: Prohibited behaviour includes 'one-sided betting' (trading one direction without adaptation), 'excessive risk' and 'toxic trading' (more than 60% of trades with a negative risk-reward profile), described as reflecting 'gambling, not disciplined trading'; consequences include profit removal, account reset, closure or permanent ban.
restrictiveRules.impact: Broadly defined trading-style categories can lead to removal of profit or closure at the firm's assessment.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Opening or closing positions within 3 minutes before or after a news release is not allowed'; holding through news is allowed.
restrictiveRules.impact: Restricts entries and exits around news releases.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'All positions must be closed before market close on Friday' (1 Step permits weekend holding).
restrictiveRules.impact: No weekend holding on the 2 Step.

restrictiveRules.rule: 'Funded accounts that remain inactive for 30 consecutive days will be suspended'; logging in does not reset the timer and a new evaluation may be required.
restrictiveRules.impact: A funded account without trades for 30 days is suspended.
